REQUIRE HIGH GRAPHICS QUALITY TO WORK

https://i.imgur.com/wEFREEP.png

https://i.imgur.com/vImUvbU.gif

http://i.imgur.com/MHQvkfj.png

I don't know how you play, but I spend most of my time on the galaxy view, and everything seems so bleak, just dust and some stars. I've been looking for a way to spice things up a bit.
No gameplay impact unfortunately, this is a pure graphical mod.
"High" graphics quality option is required, medium or low won't display the new entities.

http://i.imgur.com/3mUPw2P.png

This mod adds a plethora of visual goodies for your galaxy, regrettably they'll always spawn in the same area, there's no way to randomize it.

Satellite galaxies
https://i.imgur.com/0BIU060.png
https://i.imgur.com/jjHalCQ.gif
There are currently 3 new galaxies added:
 - The first is located at the north west, it has a spiral form and is roughly the same size as ours.
 - The second one is in the south east, a small spiral galaxy that almost touch ours when playing at 1k stars.
 - The third one is in the south south west ans is quite isolated, it is a small elogated spiral galaxy.
All of these are animated and slowly rotate on themselves.

Galactic core
https://i.imgur.com/XvDfy4I.png
https://i.imgur.com/y3f1M6H.gif
The galactic core is empty and quite sad to look at.
Now, we have a proper galactic core, in 3D and, if you look at it close enough, the stars are slowly rotating around.
A little warning, if you zoom too close, you might experience some slow down.

Globular Cluster
https://i.imgur.com/9D60Hig.png
You'll find plenty of globular cluster lying around the galaxy now.

Nebulae in 3D:
https://i.imgur.com/CgHqc8S.png
https://i.imgur.com/N6yw6Qo.png
https://i.imgur.com/sWKR0Lh.png

Nebulae in 2D:
https://i.imgur.com/tnWhYAH.png
https://i.imgur.com/ufxBPeA.png
https://i.imgur.com/NNxBClJ.png

Fantasy nebulae (using the fantastic work of [url=https://www.deviantart.com/starkiteckt]Starkiteckt)
https://i.imgur.com/4CzdMiq.png

I've made two addons available for this mod:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1445669234]https://i.imgur.com/KjaPnWZ.png
The quadrant addon will add 4 rotating circles to define the various part of the galaxy as well as captions. It is an addon, as many might not like it.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1445669162]https://i.imgur.com/06hKzTp.png
The L-Cluster addon will add animated dust, cpation and some nebulae for the L-Cluster, even before it is discovered. Removed from main mod for people not having distant stars (but they can still use it).

These two addons can now be used as standalone.

http://i.imgur.com/ov0QyWq.png
The mod is completely save game compatible, you can activate/deactivate the mod without any impact. Works on previous save games.

https://i.imgur.com/fU7aGnH.png

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1085097357]https://i.imgur.com/Em919sf.png
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1128927140]https://i.imgur.com/LYRHaeq.png
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1173995428]https://i.imgur.com/Fmk5em0.png
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1242221332]https://i.imgur.com/db6bSym.png
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1412637064]https://i.imgur.com/ww6WKBK.png

http://i.imgur.com/5dSrh9R.png

http://i.imgur.com/JYmFoSu.png Achievment compatible.

Compatible with any mod that does not alter the "default_galaxy_center_entity".

KNOWN BUGS :
 - Every time a portrait is active on screen when player is on galaxy view, the entities incorporated by this mod disappear. This include tabs such as governement/contact/sectors, and fleets with leaders, such as military or science ships. Closing the tab/fleet resolve the issue.
 - Opening the ship designer in galaxy view make animated parts of the mod (galactic core, companion galaxies, quadrant) to spin VERY fast. Closing it resolve the issue.


https://i.imgur.com/jJ5MXKG.png


    [*]1.0.1:
 - Fixed missing texture.
 - Quadrant & L cluster can now be used as standalone, although they'll give some (harmless) warnings in the log.


http://i.imgur.com/bNv5m6t.png

A big thank you to [url=https://www.deviantart.com/starkiteckt]Starkiteckt, he allowed me to use his great work in this mod. Go check it out!

Bring more life to your Galaxy!
Dynamic Galaxy Overhaul tweaks the Stellaris experience in various ways and adds more depth and diversity to the game.

Have you ever wanted more depth to the Great Khan? Now he can actually become Galactic Emperor!
Have you ever thought that various different government types would specifically think higher or lower about each other? Here you go! Tons of new greetings, diplomatic texts, opinion modifiers, events and more.


[url=https://discord.gg/jkTY5z9RKE]https://i.imgur.com/VFsGyu4.png


What this mod adds:
- Tons of new Events + flavor

- Tons of new Greeting Lines

- Tons of new Diplo First Contact Lines

- New Policies
        - Livestock Farming Methods
        - Regards to Civilians during Invasions

- New Slavery Forms
        - Sapient Decoration (Only available to Plantoids/Fungoids)
        - Sapient Smart Homes (Black Mirror S2E4) -> Requires the 'Corporate Sapience' Government

- New Government Types
	- Narcotic Syndicate
	- Feudal League
        - Necromancer Horde
        - Cult of Appearance
	- Empathic Swarm
	- Fungal Infection
	- Symbiotic Swarm
	- Rogue Warbots
	- Autonomous Aid System
	- Resource Extraction System (Requires Hyperconstructs' Star Lifter Origin)
	- Planetary Computing Complex (Requires Gigastructures)

- New AI Personalities
	- Empathic Swarm
	- Reprocessing Hive
	- Rogue Appeasement System
	- Determined Servitors
	- Organic Reprocessors
        - Cult of Appearance
	

- New Opinion Modifiers for certain Personalities/Ethics towards each other
	- Servitor & Xenophiles
	- Servitor & Pacifists
	- Servitor & Militarists
	- Machine Slavers & Organics
	- Capitalists & Capitalists
	- Technocary Civic & Machine
	- Communist & Communist

- New Optional Midgame Crisis: The Cold War
	- Fanatic Egalitarian/Cooperative Country gets Option to create communist federation if any fanatic competitive/authoritarian Country exists
	- Fanatic competitive/authoritarian Country gets Option to create counter-federation
	- If more than one Gestalt exists, they will get an Option to form a third bloc under their Leadership

- Great Khan:
	- If all GalCom members surrender to the Khan, the Galactic Imperium will be created under the Khan's leadership
	- Time till Khan dies increased

- The Great Galactic War
	- If a war breaks out that includes at least 50% of the galaxy's member states, a flavor Event will trigger and the war will be renamed into the Great Galactic War

- Flavor Events for Purifiers, Terminators & Devouring Swarms
	- Fired when the last opposing Country is destroyed

- The Unholy Alliance
	- Devouring Swarms can get the Option to secretly contact a Terminator Empire to offer an uneasy Peace... and cooperation.
	- Rare Event that can be triggered when a Terminator and a Devouring Swarm exist

- Infinity Thesis
	- Chance of Guardians of the Galaxy Awakening increased (From 1% to 33%)

- Purges
	- Enabled for Pacifist Empires, but regular Purge Type disabled for pacifists
	- Weights of various Purge Types tweaked

- More New Opinion Modifiers

--- (Disabled for now, Re-Enabled in next Update) ---

- New Purge Type: Lobotomy


- Full Bug Branch, Gigastructures & Hyperconstructs Support!

-------------

Should you encounter any bugs with other mods, feel free to let me know and I will seek to add compatibility.

Enjoy!

translations.description_clean:
Smarter AI for building hyper relays

Does the AI seem a little haphazard when building hyper relays? And then builds them more-or-less everywhere? This mod fixes that.

With this mod, AI empires build proper networks starting at capitals, branching to sector capitals, then to other colonies.

Details
Every year, this mod finds and marks the shortest path from capitals to sector capitals, and from sector capitals to sector colonies. Paths to wormholes/gateways/catapults and border fortresses are also found (from sector capital if in a sector, otherwise from empire capital). A path along an existing relay is considered twice as short, to encourage the AI to re-use existing relays. The AI then only builds relays in systems that border an existing relay they own and are on one of those paths, with the following exceptions:

 [*] The empire's capital (this let's them get their network started)
 [*] Sector capitals that are at least 10 years old and have no path to the capital (this let's them build a separate network if they have a non-contiguous empire, for example on the other side of a wormhole)


Overlords will build paths to the their subject capitals, and will build paths through subjects if they have an isolated sector on the other side.

In addition to normal building of hyper relays using construction ships, the AI gets to build up to 1 hyper relay each year without using a construction ship. They still pay the resources for it, and only do it if they have a large stockpile of resources (10x the required resources). This is to address 2 vanilla issues with the AI:

 [*] The AI isn't good at managing it's construction ships, sometimes sending one from the east side of it's empire all the way build something in the west, while at the same time sending a one from the west to build in the east, wasting months or even years. This "cheat" helps make up for lost time.
 [*] Sometimes, especially after unlocking other megastructures, the AI stops building hyper relays, even if their resource stockpiles are completely full. This "cheat" lets AIs with strong economies continue expanding their relay networks into the late game.


This has been tested for performance on a huge galaxy and has no noticeable impact.

Compatibility

  [*] For Stellaris 4.4.*
  [*] NOT achievement compatible
  [*] Can be added to an existing game, but works best if the AI has not started building hyper relays yet
  [*] Can be removed from an existing game
  [*] Compatible with Gigastructural Engineering and More (load order does not matter)
  [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3241944359]shrimpAI for Total Conversions is a separate version that provides compatibility for some total conversion mods
  [*] Compatible with Sparsity and Wild Space 3 (enables building hyper relays in unclaimable space for both player and AI; load order does not matter)
  
    [*] To retain the cheaper Hyper Relay costs of Sparsity, use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2842476749]Cheaper Relays Submod
  
  [*] Should be compatible with all other mods, except other mods that override hyper relays
  
    [*] Note for patch makers: this only overrides the hyper_relay megastructure, and within that, only changes the ai_weight
  


Sharing
Feel free to update, pack, patch, translate, fork, or incorporate this mod, no prior permission required. Credit, linking to the original mod, and letting me know is appreciated!

translations.title_zh_current: 更聪明的超空间中继：改进 AI（Smarter Hyper Relays）
translations.summary_zh_current: 让 AI 帝国像玩家一样按网络规划建造超空间中继，而非乱建一气。
translations.description_zh_current:
本 MOD 让 AI 帝国像人类玩家一样规划超空间中继网络：从首都起步、分支到星区首都、再延伸到其他殖民地，而不是到处乱建一气。适配群星 4.4.*。
• 路径规划：每年找出首都→星区首都、星区首都→星区殖民地的全局最短路径，同时规划通往虫洞/星门/量子弹射器与边境堡垒的路径（星区内的从星区首都出发，否则从帝国首都出发）；已有中继的路径视为「两倍短」，鼓励 AI 复用现有中继。
• 建造规则：AI 只在与自己已有中继相邻、且位于规划路径上的星系建造；例外是帝国首都（用于启动网络），以及存在 10 年以上、无路径连接首都的星区首都（可在地图另一端如虫洞对岸建立独立网络）。霸主会向附属国首都修路，遇到隔离星区也会穿越附属国领土修路。
• 附加机制：AI 每年可额外放置最多 1 个中继而不使用建造船（仍需支付资源，且仅在资源库存达到所需 10 倍时才执行），用于弥补其建造船调度低效与后期停止扩建中继的两个原版缺陷；作者称在超大银河测试无明显性能影响。
• 兼容性：不兼容成就模式；可加入或移出进行中的存档；与 Gigastructural Engineering and More 兼容（加载顺序无关）；与 Sparsity and Wild Space 3 兼容（附保留其廉价中继成本的子模）；另为总转换 MOD 提供单独版本。
• 其他：除超空间中继的 ai_weight 外不覆盖其他内容，作者欢迎自由修改、翻译与打包。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: AI 建造超空间中继更符合逻辑，减少无意义节点，提升中继网络利用效率。
translations.reviews_zh_current: AI 行为优化实用 MOD，订阅 2.4 万+。

Vanilla has space elves, so I made space pixies.

Contents

Animated Portrait Set
Animated humanoid set. They twitch, and blink, and look around, and breathe, just like vanilla portraits. They have different skins, faces, sexual dimorphism, different clothes, and several different hairstyles and clothes.

Custom City Set
Spunky neon purple city, based on the mammalian set.

Custom Name List
Generic xeno-humanoid name list, completely new.

Custom Starting Solar System
The Taxeema system, a simple, clean start on a temperate world with two small sea moons, orbiting a yellow sun.

Custom AI Personality
If my Custom Empire (and only that one) of Xirmians is moved by the AI, it will acquire by default the Flamboyant Diplomats personality. It makes the AI focus on speed and shields for his ships, and be very open to trade and diplomacy. Yet, unlike vanilla “peaceful” personalities, Flamboyant Diplomats will still partake in war and Nation-building occasionally. The personality is also paired with about 50 new lines of dialogue for the various diplomatic messages, which provide multiple reactions for each vanilla species_class.
If you use my Custom Empire, you'll still have access to some of this content through the tailored custom insults that your diplomat will be able to send to other empires. 

Custom Empire
The Xirmian Astral Concordate. It’s a Direct Democracy, xenophile/materialist/individualist. Since this mod does not add any gameplay, I’ve set this Empire as capable of spawning on its own (although it won’t spawn always), unless the player is using it, in which case it will never spawn.
If you wish to disable the Empire from spawning without using it yourself, you need to either disable the mod before starting up Stellaris, or go to the mod folder (Steam/SteamApps/workshop/content/281990/... /xirmian_portraits/prescripted_countries/) open the xirmian_prescripted_countries file, search for spawn_enabled=yes, and edit it to: spawn_enabled=no.
You can also edit it to: spawn_enabled=always, if you wish the Xirmian Astral Concordate to always be spawned in your games (although it’ll still be automatically disabled if you are using it yourself, in order to avoid having twin empires).

Compatibility
This mod does not affect any vanilla files, nor does it add any gameplay feature. I don’t think it should cause any conflict with most other mods, although there might be exceptions I haven’t thought of.

Welcome to the revival of the ever popular [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2062846721]Additional Vanilla Weapons!  Originally created by the great Sam_, it has been kept alive by the community since Sam_'s disappearance.  This overhaul was started from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3146034056]3.10 files uploaded by Anarchy.


What is this mod?  What does it do?  Sam_ would say....
[quote=Sam_]This mod adds 62 new weapons to extend the vanilla weapon tree, with the aim of doubling the number of weapons and technologies in a way that is vanilla friendly. Simply the same weapons in the base game, times two. It adds additional tiers beyond what the base game has, now with 10 tiers of laser, mass driver and missiles.

About
Most weapon sets have been doubled, except Kinetic Artillery, Mass Accelerators and Energy Lances which have 7 tiers instead of 2. The tech cost for each technology in this mod increases exponentially, instead of linearly as the base game does, making the final 10th tier a significant task to research even during end game.

If you play Stellaris like me, you always go for a technological ascendancy, producing as much research as possible. That means by the start of mid-game you have reached the final tier of lasers or mass drivers and you will spend the rest of the game watching the more primitive empires catch up to you. In reality a highly advanced society focused on technology would continue to advance without limits.

With this mod you can continue to advance until end game, way beyond the capabilities of even the Fallen Empires.

Changes

[*]Adds 162 new components (Need to recount)

Balance

translations.title_en: Disable AI Archaeology and Astral Rift Exploration
translations.description_clean:
Disable AI Archaeology and Astral Rift Exploration

Specific Features:

·All vanilla archaeological sites: AI cannot excavate them
·Mod-added archaeological sites: AI excavation difficulty is set to infinite, and progress will never increase
·AI cannot explore Astral Rifts, even if they have researched the Rift Sphere technology
·AI cannot gain progress in the situation required to unlock Rift Sphere technology

====================

Usage Notes:
This mod only modifies vanilla parameters and can be added or removed at any time.
To prevent its parameters from being overwritten by other mods, it is recommended to load this mod after others.
Supports version 4.0.*. If future updates do not change the relevant code or logic, the mod will remain compatible.

If you’re unsure whether the mod is being overridden, you can use human_ai for simple testing before starting a full playthrough. Suggested testing methods:
-- Research Rift Sphere using: research_technology tech_rift_sphere
-- Test 1 reference: After using human_ai, right-click on an archaeological site with a science ship. It should show as unexcavatable, with no assignable scientists.
-- Test 2 reference: Right-click on a mod-added site and begin excavation. Then enable human_ai; the excavation difficulty should become infinite and progress should never increase.
-- Test 3 reference: After researching Rift Sphere, the player can explore Astral Rifts normally, but under human_ai, rifts will still show as lacking the required technology and remain unexaminable.

Q: Why are the methods for blocking vanilla and modded archaeological sites different?
-- Currently, there are two main methods to restrict AI archaeology. The first is to apply heavy debuffs to AI excavation speed and difficulty, but this can cause AI scientists to waste time stuck in sites (possibly indefinitely), which may lead to imbalance under the leader system. The second method is to add explicit AI-blocking logic to each site, completely preventing the AI from assigning scientists. This is more effective but only works for vanilla content, since it's not possible to predict what custom sites other mods may add.
This mod includes both methods. If another mod has modified vanilla sites, simply load this mod before it. As long as no later mod changes common\game_rules\00_rules.txt, this mod will still function properly.

Sincerest apologies but my interests have moved elsewhere and I no longer have the time or inclination to continue maintaining my mods. I hereby authorize anyone who wishes to do so to utilize my mods for their own as they see fit, provided you attribute the original source. 



Ever felt like the Nanites in Stellaris were pretty useless? I did, and I made this mod to correct that. Exploring hypothetical technologies in scales from the Micro to the Atto and everything between, the mod offers a plethora of new options for empires, many of which are derived from the sci-fi encyclopedia at Orion's Arm. All heavily integrate Nanites and make them an essential component of cutting edge empires. Three variations of the ascension perk to start your nanotechnology journey have been included; one for Organic Empires, one for Synths, and one for Machine empires.

The mod adds 40+ new technologies; 5 new ship components, including a Colossus Planet Killer that turns worlds into Nanite worlds and access to the unique model of Strike Craft from the Grey Tempest; two new buildings; two new megastructures, one of which is a giant AI entity who’s “personality” you get to influence; a series of upgradable planet modifiers; a new planet bombardment stance; three new armies with a unique icon; and a set of traits for Synths and Machines equivalent to the Brain Slug for Organics.

The mod has a few overwrites, so some graphical issues may occur with other mods. The mod has graphical changes to the orbital_bombardment_effects entity, and the GFX_planet_view_bombarded sprite; and the event syndaw.10 has been altered. Compatibility for Gigastructural Engineering has been included by default; Nanite Expansion should go after Gigas in the load order for all graphical effects to work.

The full mod documentation can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vT3nr03aAEjxLBPIIKEdtvgF1tSk9VwqCy2SZcBPrWedbQy6oQ1nlwCKKy546lKKaqQOmaOP5p_IZlH/pub]here.

Prepare to encounter a new and terrifying menace, The Eye of Terror, a challenging and dynamic mid and end game Crisis. Watch as the experiments or decadence of the Fallen Empires bring forth a progressively more challenging threat. Interwoven with the Shroud and psionic features from the Utopia DLC, the mod aims to change the dynamic of your playthroughs with new stories, challenges and opportunities. This layered crisis will grow in difficulty and will shift depending on the luck or misfortune of your session. While there are encounters that may destroy you, unlike usual crises that spawn massive fleets, its goal is to start off as a constant menace to the galaxy and can only be sealed through great effort. A slow and insidious killer. This mod does not replace the existing crisis and they can occur simultaneously.

Although influenced by HP Lovecraft and the Warhammer Universe event of the same name, the storytelling is built to be immersive, to flow with the lore of Stellaris and aims to make the content feel integrated rather than intrusive. Although the difficulty can be increased for a modded game, its baseline is made for vanilla.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2809452753/4839692156577380383/]TLDR: Visit the FAQ page for a direct explanation of features or if anything is unclear.

https://i.imgur.com/1ZYgDys.png
https://i.imgur.com/ku50ZUe.png
Navigate your empire through 50+ events and multiple story chains leading up to and following the Shroud tear within your galaxy. Explore an ancient Precursor archaeological site to find new ways to combat this enigmatic threat or simply do your best to contain it with your own research chain. Find ways to work together with the Galactic Community with new resolutions, buildings, operations and technologies. Use this new danger as a tool to destroy your enemies, as new Gods to worship or work tirelessly to seal the rifts and free the galaxy from the grip of terror. 

https://i.imgur.com/fSBotUE.png
https://i.imgur.com/OQQu37M.png
Depending on your settings the crisis will have a chance to trigger after reaching midgame.  A slow buildup of events will hint at the upcoming danger as rifts randomly begin to spawn in the galaxy.  During this time, small but manageable enemies will emerge from these rifts to harass your reality. As several decades pass, the Eye of Terror itself will spawn and the chance of truly dangerous adversaries will begin.  If you or the AI are able to seal the major rifts in the galaxy, you will then be able to close off the Eye of Terror. But beware, if it falls into the wrong hands, it can be re-opened.

https://i.imgur.com/zylcBHo.png
https://i.imgur.com/Hr8LHVr.png
Fight a variety of threats crawling out from the Shroud designed to corrupt and devour life in the Galaxy. Different adversaries such as cultists and entities have unique goals and behaviours. The enemy spawn system is built on randomized probability to ensure each playthrough unique and possibly more challenging. Every spawn is individual, meaning if entities or different cults run into each other, they will fight one another -leading to interesting stories or unexpected saviours.

https://i.imgur.com/ibbXHOL.png
The mod is completely independent and affects no vanilla files, it should be playable with all other mods.  It has been tested with large mods (NSC, Giga, etc) and crisis manager mods with no issues (yet). It does not replace the existing crisis, so it is possible that it spawns alongside the others. 

Events are broken if using mods that allow you to be new country types such as an ascended Empire.

Works with multiplayer.

https://i.imgur.com/SR6yWgs.png
Can be added at any point in your saved game, a special popup will appear at the end of the month for spawn chance. No issues that I know of (as of yet).

“Life out here began out there.”
-- Commander Adama, Battlestar Galactica

Distant Origin is a mod that expands on the Lost Colony and Remnants origins added in Federations, and adds a few of its own. Players can choose to start as such a lost colony: cut off from the homeworld, isolated for centuries, and looking to explore the universe in search of their ancestral planet. Or you can play as a race of refugees exiled by an invading alien race, desperate to retake their homeworld at all costs. Or you can play as the homeworld itself, searching the universe for your own lost colonies scattered throughout the galaxy. There are a lot of possibilities, and virtually all of them should be compatible with most mods since no significant vanilla files are touched.

For more information, see the wiki page [url=https://stellaris.paradoxwikis.com/Distant_Origin]here.

Description 
My version of the Warhammer 40K-based, the Imperium of Man ship mod, We Are The Imperial Navy.

Mod was originally [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2046004675]Paragon's We Are The Imperial Navy Mod that uses ships from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=864541681]Reiseafa's We Are The Imperial Navy Mod. A majority of the ships in this mod are reworked or replaced versions of Paragon & Reiseafa's ship models to varying degrees. 

How did I make this mod? Modelling - Autodesk MAYA, Texturing - GIMP 3.10, Graphics & Thumbnails - CLIP STUDIO PAINT, File Editing - Visual Studio Code.

 Uni update: I'm still very much in the thick of my degree at the moment and my most stressful period is still ahead of me. Updates aren't guaranteed and/or will be infrequent. I'll continue to support the mod in the next upcoming Stellaris patch but no guarantees after Stellaris 3.8/3.9. 

Ships
Science/Construction Ship: Adeptus Mechanicus Light Cruiser (scaled down)
Corvette: Sword Frigate
Frigate: Cobra Destroyer
Destroyer: Firestorm, Tempest, Falchion Frigates and Turbulent Heavy Frigate
Cruiser: Endeavour, Endurance, Defiant Light Cruisers
Strike Cruiser: Dauntless Mk. I, Dauntless Mk. II, Enforcer Light Cruisers
Exploration Cruiser: Adeptus Mechanicus Lunar Cruiser
Escort Carrier (now a section of the Battle Cruiser): Dictator and Jovian Cruisers
Battle Cruiser: Overlord, Mars, Gothic, Lunar Cruisers and Battle Cruisers
Battleship: Vengeance, Avenger, Exorcist Grand Cruisers
Carrier: Battle Barge
Dreadnought: Retribution, Emperor, Oberon Battleships
Titan: Apocalypse Battleship
Flagship: Apocalypse Battleship (placeholder)
Fortress: Ramilies Starfort
Juggernaut: Phalanx
Headquarters: Blackstone Fortress
Colossus: Inquisitorial Black Ship

and more models unmentioned...

Updates
All previous updates can be seen in the change notes tab. Just the latest updates can be seen below:

V2.0 Update - Armada - Major Update - New models for Destroyer, Cruiser, Strike Cruiser, Battlecruiser, Battleship with texture overhauls to most ships and fixes for many texture and model bugs. New technology system allowing for Imperium-exclusive ship sections. Made some optimisations to total mod file size. 

V1.11.0 Update - Titans - New ship section models for the Dreadnought model, including reworks to the Emperor-class Battleship model, and the addition of the Oberon and Retribution Battleship model variants for the NSC2 Dreadnought. New model for the Titan(and Flagship as a placeholder): Apocalypse-class Battleship. Reworks to their textures.

V1.10.1 Update - Minor reworks/fidelity update to Emperor-class Battleship (Dreadnought model & texture) and Blackstone Fortress animation. Replaced Titan model with current Dreadnought model due to how out of place the model for the Apocalypse looks in this shipset (kept it for Flagship). This is just a placeholder and will be replaced again in the next major mod update. Fixed stretched texture on Cruiser (Endeavour) bow.

V1.10.0 Update - Blistering Iron - Major reworks to: Corvette, Frigate, Destroyer, Strike Cruiser models to increase fidelity. Replaced Cruiser model which was previously another Dauntless (Strike Cruiser) with the Endeavour-class Light Cruiser model, (my first model made fully from scratch - other models used a pre-made base that I modelled on top of). Added in spinning idle and moving animation for the Blackstone fortress model (Headquarters).

V1.9.1 Update - Further edits to Light Carrier relay towers. Fixed missing polygons on updated models as well as fixed some texture bugs on both updated models.

Load Order 
This mod should be placed [url=https://prnt.sc/skrhx4]above [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=683230077]NSC2 in the load order. Files and folders in this mod should not conflict with any other mod.

Future Updates and Suggestions
The end goal in my case is to implement a Gloriana-class battleship model (based off the Macragge's Honour) as the flagship model. However, it will take me an enormous amount of time to model and texture. Alas, the chances of this happening in the near future are slim-to-none (Further update: Due to the large amount of assets I've built up over reworking a ton of ships, I'm now in a good position to model the Gloriana this summer. No promises though).

Plans for the next update involves reworks to the larger capital ship models such as the Battleship, Carrier, and Titan. Planned for release during Stellaris 3.8.

Otherwise; see mod discussions tab.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/Silfae] http://i.imgur.com/Oi4ncTS.png  

Contents

Animated Portrait Set
Four fully animated silicoid portrait sets.
They twitch, and blink, and look around, and breathe, just like vanilla portraits. 
The more human-like sets have alternate faces, hair and sexual dimorphism.
You can easily use this set to create any Custom Empire you like, just like for the vanilla portraits.

Custom City Set
Industrial/underground city.

Custom Archetype
The silicoid species class uses a separate archetype, which means they are not considered Biological. This results in the special "Silicoid" trait being applied to any species created using one of the new portraits and on a separate list of traits being available for them.
Silicoids have a stronger fortification defense and garrison health, and they don't need regular food to sustain themselves, but they have decreased growth and experience gain. They consume a very small amount of Energy and a lot more minerals compared to organics though (in the form of a consumer good malus).
The "Silicoid" trait is always applied on a silicoid species and cannot be removed unless the species undergoes a Synthetic Ascension.
All three Ascension paths are available as in vanilla, although of course Biologic ascension will only give access to the silicoid traits.

Custom Traits
Just like Synthetics, Silicoids do not have the vanilla traits to pick from. When the player creates a new Empire using their portraits, a new selection of custom silicoid traits will be available for use.

Custom Civics
Two new civics have been made available for silicoid species: Living World and Terraformers. The former grants a significant boost in Unity output, the latter allows the player's Empire to start with the first two terraforming technologies already researched.

Custom Ship Set
The vanilla synthetic ships, made available for use for any player-created custom Empire.

Custom Empires
The Taclariotan Influence and the Mandate of Druerd. The first is an Illuminated Autocracy (materialist/xenophobic/authoritarian), the second a Theocratic Dictatorship (spiritualist/fanatic authoritarian).I’ve set these two Empires as capable of spawning on their own (although they won’t spawn always), unless the player is using one of them, in which case that one will never spawn.
If you wish to disable the Empires from spawning without using either yourself, you need to either disable the mod before starting up Stellaris, or go to the mod folder (Steam/SteamApps/workshop/content/281990/... /silicoid_portraits/prescripted_countries/) open the octeelan_prescripted_countries file, search for spawn_enabled=yes, and edit it to: spawn_enabled=no.
You can also edit it to: spawn_enabled=always, if you wish either of the two Empire to always be spawned in your games.

Compatibility
This mod does not affect any vanilla files, nor does it add any gameplay feature. I don’t think it should cause any conflict with most other mods, although there might be exceptions I haven’t thought of.

translations.description_zh_current: 警告：请勿单独订阅此模组！PDX 原版纹理不错但缺乏多样性，大陆型星球千篇一律，气态巨行星尤其明显。星球多样化（Planet Variety）大幅增强群星视觉效果，为星球带来急需的视觉差异。本模组仅包含各星球包所需的新云层。

3.3 update here will be avaiable soon, updated by original author

Legendary Worlds 3.2.2
Updated with the kind permission of the author.
Original mod here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1373224279

Updated Planetary Diversity compatibility.
General pass on the modifiers/triggers.
Tweaks here and there.
APSR mod compatibility.
GPM mod compatibility.


Bugs are bound to happen, lemme know if you find any. I'm not a great modder in any way but it'll try to sort it out.
Also, sugestions on new modifiers or changes to existing ones are always welcome.

WIP:
Implementation of archaeology dig sites to provide legendary modifiers.
Updating Legendary Ocean planet modifiers to account Aquiatic Species additions.



Legendary Worlds


This mods adds special planets (legendary worlds) by giving them a planet modifier. Most of them will have a huge buff on certain areas. Planets on vanilla are mostly the same and this feels boring. So this mod adds a planet variety and diversity in a special way, not completely overhauling everything. It can change a lot of balance, but it still does not feel game-breaking. If you find two extra good vanilla worlds of your type in early that can be quite unbalanced too. The chances are very small, but if you are lucky and find a legendary world next to your homeworld it makes you a lucky one. Since 2.2 update, all major bonus legendary modifiers are balanced in a way you will enjoy them if you find them early or near your homeworld, but it will take a lot of efforts to fully unlock their capabilities. This is the mostly big Change within the 2.2. update.

Also there are three "different" world classes:

Common and Uncommon Legendaries

There is a set of three rather common legendary planets and a lot more that occur more often (about 1 of 20 planets). One for each climate: Ocean, Continental and Tropical worlds can get a food bonus, cold weather planets can get a mineral bonus and hot climate planets can get a energy bonus. So every empire will get a unique bonus once colonized enough worlds of their type. These are rather minor buffs, compared to other legendaries.

Rare Legendaries

There are lot of very powerful modifiers, that most planets can get on random. They are really rare, and in a small galaxy you might have only 1 or 2 of this kind in the whole game. So if you play several games, you will find a new legendary from time to time. Here legendary buffs are quite decent and very unique, but most of it will only shine from the mid-game on. So if you find one these in the early game, you will find it very hard to use them unless you got more advanced technology or generally more income to make a expense for getting a colony up here.

True Legendaries

True legendary Worlds are the rarest of all Worlds. It could happen that there will be not even a single planet within the whole Galaxy. This can happen even on 1000 stars Maps, but its more unlikely. Their bonuses are mighty ones, for which Empires will fight to death. Find them and ensure them for your empire!


Ancients and Buildings

This mod adds a fallen precursor race, called ancients (very creative, i know). You can find buildings from them randomly on any world (doesn't have to a legendary world). If you are more lucky you can even find a whole ancient colony with more special ancients buildings. Rumors say that there can also spawn an ancient homeworld from time to time.
All other new buildings added within this mod belong to a special legendary, so they can only be built on those worlds. That's because i dont want to add more "everywhere buildable" buildings to the game, as they are more than plenty on the workshop.

Included

30 new legendary modifier
19 new special Buildings
8 new specialst jobs
5 new survey events
3 new technologies
3 new mini Events
a lot of unique planet tiles


Compatibility

Compatible with all DLC.
DLCs not required.
Language files for every language included. (all texts english only)

No vanilla files were harmed during the modding process. Should be fully compatible with almost any mod.
However there can only be ONE file in the game for borders of planet modifiers. Any mod which alters this file, will consult in small graphic bug (you wont see the legendary borders around a planetary modifier).

Guillis Planet Modifier: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=865040033

I made my file for border_frames to be fully compatible with both mods and Guilliman has replaced his file with mine. So this both mods have 100% compability despite using the same ressources. Thanks to him for adapting his mod!


Full compatibility with Planetary Diversity

Have Fun finding all legendaries :)

I have tested every legendary ingame, they all did their job working. But i am no modding expert, so please feel free to report any bugs/strange behaviors as they occur, and i will see what i can do.

Spawn frequency has really a lot of random modifiers and are also dependend on spawned planet classes. Different games may have different spawn rates of legendaries.

Updates
V2.4:
Minor balancing changes regarding Timeshifted Planets.
Increased Bonus for Basic Legendary Mining Planets.

V2.3:
Added some new Modifiers as well a huge balance update.
(Detailed description lost to the imba-gay-new-♥♥♥♥-game launcher)

Be aware that legendary modifiers will only spawn at game start (some days afterwards). You can safley add this mod to a savegame, but you can get only legedaries from terraforming or megastructures. Not going to change that!

translations.summary_zh_current: 为星球添加传奇级世界修饰与事件，仅适配群星 3.2.x。
translations.description_zh_current:
本 MOD 是在原作者许可下更新的传奇世界（Legendary Worlds）3.2.2 版本，以星球修饰形式生成特殊星球，大多数提供某些领域的大幅加成，在不大改全盘的前提下显著增加星球多样性与探索惊喜。注意：标题明确仅适配群星 3.2.x。
• 分级设计：常见/不常见传奇——约每 20 颗星球出现一次，每种气候各有一类（海洋/大陆/热带世界食物加成、寒冷世界矿物加成、炎热世界能量加成），加成相对温和；稀有传奇——强而独特，小银河整局可能只有一两颗；真传奇——全银河甚至可能一颗都没有，加成强大到帝国愿为其开战。
• 其他内容：新增远古（Ancients）先驱种族，其建筑可随机出现在任何世界，运气好还能发现完整远古殖民地甚至远古母星；另有 30 个新传奇修饰、19 个新特殊建筑、8 个新专业岗位、5 个新勘察事件、3 个新技术、3 个新迷你事件与大量独特星球地块。
• 生成机制：传奇修饰仅在开局（数天后）生成；可安全加入已有存档，但之后只能通过地形改造或巨构获得传奇。
• 兼容性：兼容全部 DLC 且不要求 DLC；不修改原版文件；与 Planetary Diversity 完全兼容；与 Guilli's Planet Modifier 的边框文件 100% 兼容；语言文件齐备但所有文本仅英语。
• 维护说明：WIP——将实现考古现场提供传奇修饰、按水生物种更新海洋传奇世界；作者自谦非资深 MOD 作者，欢迎反馈 Bug 与建议。
